const int MOD = 1000000007;

int modpow(int a, int e) {
    int res = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) res = (1LL * res * a) % MOD;
        a = (1LL * a * a) % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    array<array<int, 6>, 6> pr = {};
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> pr[i][j];
            pr[i][j] = (1LL * pr[i][j] * modpow(100, MOD - 2)) % MOD;
        }
    for (int i = n; i < 6; ++i) pr[i][i] = 1;

    vector<int> m3;
    map<int, int> mp;
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 6); ++i)
        if (__builtin_popcount(i) == 3) {
            m3.push_back(i);
            mp[i] = (int)m3.size() - 1;
        }
    assert(mp.size() == 20);

    array<int, 20> comp = {};
    for (auto &p : mp)
        comp[p.second] = mp[p.first ^ 63];

    array<int, 1 << 18> sub0, sub1, mas;
    sub0.fill(1);
    sub1.fill(1);
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
                int bit = 1 << (i * 3 + j);

                    sub1[mask] = (1LL * sub1[mask] * pr[i][3 + j]) % MOD;

                }
            }
        }
        int ind = 0;
        for (int m : m3) {
            vector<int> guys;
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
                if (m & (1 << i)) guys.push_back(i);
            bool bad = false;
            for (int xd = 0; xd < (1 << 3); ++xd) {
                int ms = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k)
                    if (xd & (1 << k))
                        ms |= (mask >> (guys[k] * 3)) & 7;
                if (__builtin_popcount(xd) > __builtin_popcount(ms)) {
                    bad = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
